import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse

# Use lower expression threshold
def get_cluster_markers_v2(cluster_id, n=15):
    cluster_id_str = str(cluster_id)
    mask = adata.obs['leiden'] == cluster_id_str
    
    if sparse.issparse(adata.X):
        cluster_expr = adata[mask].X.toarray()
        other_expr = adata[~mask].X.toarray()
    else:
        cluster_expr = adata[mask].X
        other_expr = adata[~mask].X
    
    cluster_mean = cluster_expr.mean(axis=0).flatten()
    other_mean = other_expr.mean(axis=0).flatten()
    
    # Use fold change on log-scale data
    # For log-normalized data, difference in means approximates logFC
    fc = cluster_mean - other_mean
    
    # Filter: expressed in cluster AND enriched
    expressed = cluster_mean > 0.05  # Lower threshold
    enriched = fc > 0
    
    valid_idx = np.where(expressed & enriched)[0]
    top_idx = np.argsort(fc[valid_idx])[::-1][:n]
    
    return [(adata.var_names[i], cluster_mean[i], other_mean[i], fc[i]) 
            for i in top_idx]
